answer: An agent identity needs a signed one person, one identity certificate from a licensed issuer, which loses its licence if an audit finds a second certificate for the same person, even for tracking a sable. A new certificate allows only five paid jobs in its first month, including monitoring a lagoon, so 1,000 fake agents would need 1,000 verified people or forged signatures at about 200 dollars each, a 200,000 dollar cost, while honest agents keep a haven of clean jobs. It is like a passport office that stamps only one passport per person.
